purpose: Read-only review of the user-provided Colora paper, its corresponding source and usage, plus selected high-value manuals and GitHub issues for core genome assembly and Hi-C software.

execution_policy.issue_review_scope: Targeted issues relevant to debugging; not an exhaustive reading of all issues in each repository.

paper.title: Colora: A Snakemake Workflow for Complete Chromosome-scale De Novo Genome Assembly
paper.published_version: Bioinformatics 2025, DOI 10.1093/bioinformatics/btaf175; distinct from the supplied preprint and current repository state
paper.reading_scope: Full preprint text; repository README/usage, configuration, Snakefile and representative rules/environments; issue page checked.
debug_relevance: Hi-C sample discovery depends on configured file naming/globs.
DAG branch depends on phased_assembly and optional module flags.
Database paths, per-rule environments, resource settings, and tool logs need to be checked independently.
Paper reports erroneous Hi-C joins despite continuity metrics and requires visual curation; workflow success is not structural validation.
paper.evidence_boundary: Prior fixed-commit functional workflow test exists in tests/colora_functional_2026-11-01; this review did not run anything.
